## Summary

## Verification

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] Relevant E2E/real-OpenCode tests run or explicitly skipped

## Security

- [ ] No secrets, invite URIs, tokens, bodies or decrypted payloads added to logs/tests
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes include a threat-model note
